title: Da a Wɔde Kyerɛkyerɛ a Etwa To
intro: Bere a wɔfrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmɛkyerɛ tumi kɛse bi ase no, agoruyɛfo kuw bi a wɔn ho akokwaw hui sɛ wɔrehyia nokware bi a na wɔnhwɛ kwan a ɛbɛsakra wɔn asetra koraa.
clues: Ná yɛagye din wɔ yɛn nsaanodwuma ho, na yɛyɛ adwemmɔne ne nnaadaa ho abenfo.
Sodifo no frɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛmmɛhyia ɔsɔretiafo bi a okura poma a ɛnyɛ den.
Bere a yehuu nokware no, yɛhwee fam wɔ kotow mu, kaa wiase nyinaa Awurade mu gyidi ho dawuru.
Otirimɔdenfo no hunahunaa yɛn sɛ ɔbɛtwe yɛn aso denneennen, nanso yɛanhinhim.
Yɛka wɔn a wodii kan gyee nkrasɛm no dii bere a yehuu sɛnkyerɛnne a emu da hɔ no ho.
Yɛn gyidi nti na wokunkum yɛn wɔ gyidi mu, nanso yɛn na yebedi kan ne atreneefo akɔ Paradise.

Wɔmenee wɔn wɔ ɛpo no mu
outcome.answer: Wɔbɔɔ wɔn asɛndua mu wɔ baguam

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
